# From the Analyst's Desk: Defense Technologies


Modern defense has become a networked battlefield, driving demand for AI, drones, satellites, and other advanced technology. At the same time, debt-laden governments are turning to civilian supply chains to build out their industrial bases. Senior Equity Analyst Peter Luppino explains why investors should watch the expanding ecosystem behind the military of the future.

[From the Analyst's Desk: AI and the Consumer Sector](https://www.bny.com/wealth/global/en/insights/from-the-analysts-desk-ai-and-the-consumer-sector.html)


Senior Equity Analyst Matt Keeler explains how artificial intelligence and automation are beginning to reshape the consumer sector, driving productivity gains, cost savings and faster operations. As adoption accelerates, the next few years could mark a major turning point for the industry.

[From the Analyst's Desk: Financial Services Maintains Momentum](https://www.bny.com/wealth/global/en/insights/from-the-analysts-desk-financial-services-maintains-momentum.html)


Senior Equity Analyst Don Sauber explains why he continues to favor the Financial Services sector and highlights several supportive forces behind the group’s momentum: a resilient U.S. economy, a steeper Treasury yield curve, rebounding capital markets and AI-driven efficiencies.

[2026 Mid-Year Outlook](https://www.bny.com/wealth/global/en/insights/2026-mid-year-outlook.html)

She shares our expectations for growth, inflation and earnings, and how to position portfolios in the second half.
